sense: the definite article: an (am before b f m p; an t- before a masculine vowel; a' + lenition for a feminine b c g m p); plural na (na h- before a vowel); genitive an/a', na, nan/nam
to a person or recipient; lenites (do dh'Alba); with pronouns dhomh, dhut, dha, dhi, dhuinn, dhuibh, dhaibh
to, towards, as far as a place or time; h- before a vowel (gu h-Alba)
infinitive marker: a + lenition before the verbal noun, with the object first (airson an taigh a thogail 'to build the house'); a bhith 'to be'
of, off, from among; lenites; with the article den (pl. de na); with pronouns dhìom, dhìot, dheth, dhith, dhinn, dhibh, dhiubh
'of' as possession or belonging: the genitive case, the possessed thing first (taigh a' bhàird 'the house of the poet', doras na h-eaglaise 'the door of the church')
indefinite article: Ròdais has none; a bare noun is indefinite (cù 'a dog'); aon 'one' only when the number is meant
it: e for a masculine noun and for 'it' in general (tha e fuar 'it is cold'), i for a feminine noun; emphatic esan / ise
as, like, in the role of; lenites (mar bhàrd 'as a poet')
as ... as: cho + adjective + ri (cho geal ris an t-sneachd 'as white as the snow'); before a clause cho ... 's a
as, since, because: a chionn 's gu (+ dependent verb)
as, the way that: mar a (+ relative verb: mar a thuirt mi 'as I said')
at, by (a place or person); with pronouns agam, agad, aige, aice, againn, agaibh, aca; possession is 'at' (tha cù agam 'I have a dog')
by an agent or instrument, with; h- before a vowel; with the article leis an; with pronouns leam, leat, leis, leatha, leinn, leibh, leotha
by, beside (ri taobh + genitive: ri taobh na mara 'by the sea')
by a time, before; lenites (ron oidhche 'by nightfall')
my: mo + lenition before a consonant (mo cheann), m' before a vowel or fh (m' athair); for things owned rather than part of oneself, the X agam (an taigh agam)
indefinite article (the form of 'a' before a vowel): Ròdais has none; a bare noun is indefinite (ubhal 'an apple')
your (one person, familiar): do + lenition (do cheann), d' before a vowel (d' athair), t' before fh + vowel
your (several people, or polite to one): ur, ur n- before a vowel (ur n-athair)
so, to such a degree, before an adjective: cho (cho mòr 'so big'; cho h-àrd before a vowel)
so that, in order that: gus an / los gu (+ dependent verb)
his: a + lenition (a cheann 'his head'); before a vowel a without change (a athair)
me (object and subject): mi; emphatic mise; after a preposition it fuses (agam, orm, leam)
if (a real condition): ma + independent verb (ma thig e 'if he comes'); ma tha 'if so'
if (an unreal condition): nan (nam before b f m p) + conditional (nan robh òr agam 'if I had gold')
can, be able to: is urrainn do + verbal noun (is urrainn dhomh snàmh 'I can swim'); negative chan urrainn
can, may, be allowed to (faod + verbal noun: am faod mi suidhe? 'may I sit?'); mostly future faodaidh, conditional dh'fhaodadh
tin can, a sealed metal vessel (a loan of the 1800s)
future tense: the independent future ending -idh / -aidh on the root (scrìobhaidh mi 'I will write'); the dependent form is the bare root (cha scrìobh mi)
will, wish, desire (mas e do thoil e 'if it is your will')
just, only, exactly (dìreach mar sin 'just so'; chan eil mi ach a' coimhead 'I'm just looking')
about, concerning: mu dheidhinn + genitive; with a pronoun, the possessive (mu mo dheidhinn 'about me')
about, around, approximately; lenites (mu dheich 'about ten')
out, outwards (motion: chaidh e a-mach 'he went out')
their: an (am before b f m p), no lenition (an taigh 'their house', am màthair 'their mother')
her (possessive): a without lenition, a h- before a vowel (a màthair 'her mother', a h-athair 'her father')
her (object) and she: i; emphatic ise; after a preposition it fuses (aice, oirre, leatha)
a point of time, occasion, season
a time, an instance (trì uairean 'three times'); an hour
get, obtain, find (irregular: past fhuair, future gheibh)
get to, arrive at, reach (irregular: past ràinig)
them (object) and they: iad; emphatic iadsan; after a preposition it fuses (aca, orra, leotha)
other, else (after the noun: an taobh eile 'the other side')
its: a + lenition for a masculine owner (a chòmhdach 'its cover'), a / a h- for a feminine one
our: ar, ar n- before a vowel (ar n-athair 'our father')
than, after a comparative: na, na h- before a vowel (nas motha na taigh 'bigger than a house')
him (object) and he: e; emphatic esan; after a preposition it fuses (aige, air, leis)
into a place: a-steach do, lenites; a-steach dhan with the article (chaidh e a-steach dhan taigh)
in, into (being in, turning into): ann an, ann am before b f m p
make, do (irregular: past rinn, future nì)
make someone do, compel (thug e orm falbh 'he made me leave')
over, across (thairis air: thairis air an abhainn 'over the river')
over, above (os cionn + genitive: os cionn an dorais 'over the door')
over, finished, past (tha an cath seachad 'the battle is over')
any: noun + sam bith (duine sam bith 'anyone', àite sam bith 'anywhere'); in questions and negatives gin (a bheil gin agad? 'have you any?')
the rear, the back of a thing (air cùl + genitive 'behind')
these: na + noun + seo (na taighean seo 'these houses'); as a pronoun iad seo
us (object) and we: sinn; emphatic sinne; after a preposition it fuses (againn, oirnn, leinn)
well, in a good way (tha mi gu math 'I am well')
much, a lot (+ genitive or de: mòran òir 'much gold', mòran dhaoine 'many people')
much, by far, with a comparative: fada (fada nas fheàrr 'much better'); too much: cus
even, including: eadhon, fiù 's (fiù 's a' chlann 'even the children')
shall: the future tense (-idh / -aidh on the root, as for 'will'); in offers the question form (an dùin mi an doras? 'shall I shut the door?')
really, very, before an adjective: fìor + lenition (fìor mhath 'really good')
a being, a creature, a living thing
being: a bhith, the verbal noun of bi (air a bhith 'having been')
too, excessively: ro + lenition (ro mhòr 'too big')
going: a' dol (verbal noun of rach); going to (intent): a' dol a + verbal noun (tha mi a' dol a sheinn 'I'm going to sing')
off, away from it (with verbs of taking or switching: cuir dheth 'switch off'; latha dheth 'a day off')
off, down from (thuit e bhon each 'he fell off the horse'); lenites
those: na + noun + sin (na daoine sin 'those people'); far off: ud (na beanntan ud 'those hills yonder'); as a pronoun iad sin
the earth, the globe (an cruinne-cè 'the universe')
great, excellent, splendid (before the noun, lenites: sàr laoch 'a great hero')
through; lenites (tro choille 'through a wood'); tron with the article; with pronouns tromham, tromhad, troimhe, troimhpe
last, final (after the noun: an latha mu dheireadh 'the last day')
last, previous (an t-seachdain sa chaidh 'last week')
while, as long as: fhad 's a (+ relative verb)
a while, a spell of time (tha greis ann 'it has been a while')
best: as fheàrr, the superlative of math (an caraid as fheàrr 'the best friend'); past a b' fheàrr
one's best, utmost effort (dèan do dhìcheall 'do your best')
such, such a: a leithid de (a leithid de latha 'such a day')
such, so, before an adjective: cho (duine cho laghach 'such a kind man')
look, watch (coimhead air 'look at'; coimhead airson 'look for')
a look, a glance (thoir sùil 'take a look')
something: rudeigin; in questions and negatives dad, càil
used to (a past habit): b' àbhaist do + verbal noun (b' àbhaist dhomh iasgach 'I used to fish'), or the conditional of bi (bhiodh e ...)
both: an dà + lenition + singular noun (an dà làimh 'both hands')
both, the two of them together (tha iad le chèile ann 'they're both there')
both ... and: an dà chuid ... agus
every, each: gach (gach latha 'every day'); a h-uile (a h-uile duine 'everyone')
part, portion, share, some (cuid de na daoine 'some of the people')
part of a whole, a section, a role
around, surrounding: timcheall air (timcheall air an taigh 'around the house')
around, approximately: mu thimcheall air, mu
better: nas fheàrr, comparative of math (tha e nas fheàrr 'it is better'); past na b' fheàrr; is fheàrr leam 'I prefer'
a little, a small amount (+ genitive or de: beagan uisce)
old (of things and places); before the noun seann + lenition (seann bhaile 'old town')
another: noun + eile (latha eile 'another day'); another one: fear eile (m.), tè eile (f.)
next, following: an ath + lenition (an ath-sheachdain 'next week', an ath latha 'the next day')
next to, beside: ri taobh + genitive
each one, apiece: an t-aon (scillinn an t-aon 'a penny each'); gach fear / gach tè
against, opposed to: an aghaidh + genitive (an aghaidh an rìgh); with a pronoun, the possessive (nam aghaidh 'against me')
against, leaning on, touching: ri (ris a' bhalla 'against the wall')
end, extremity, tip (ceann an rathaid 'the end of the road')
end, finish, bring to an end
must: feumaidh (defective verb) + subject + verbal noun (feumaidh mi falbh 'I must go'); or tha agam ri + verbal noun; past b' fheudar do
ever (in the past, until now: an robh thu a-riamh ann? 'were you ever there?')
free, at liberty, unbound; also cheap
someone: cuideigin; in questions and negatives duine, neach (a bheil duine ann? 'is anyone there?')
away, gone, off (fad' air falbh 'far away')
doing: a' dèanamh, verbal noun of dèan (dè tha thu a' dèanamh? 'what are you doing?')
let, allow, release (leig le 'let, allow': leig leam 'let me')
let us: the imperative 1st plural -amaid / -eamaid (rachamaid 'let us go', dèanamaid 'let us do')
real, true, genuine (before the noun, lenites: fìor charaid 'a real friend')
call, name (thug iad Iain air 'they called him Iain')
a call, a cry, a summons
done, made, finished (past participle of dèan)
a god, a deity; Dia 'God' (with a capital, no article: a Dhia! 'O God!')
a small group, a band, a party
top, upper part, surface (bho bhonn gu bàrr 'from bottom to top')
top, chief, first (before the noun, lenites)
anything: dad, càil (in questions and negatives: a bheil dad ann? 'is there anything?'); rud sam bith 'anything at all'
everything: a h-uile càil, a h-uile rud, gach nì
a stop, a halt, a pause
national, of the realm (after the noun: fiachan na rìoghachd 'national debt')
though, although: ged a (+ relative verb: ged a bha e scìth 'though he was tired'); ged nach 'though not'
American (of the people or the land)
service, serving, duty; a church service
shit, dung, excrement (also as an oath)
everyone, everybody: a h-uile duine, gach duine
a general, a commander of an army
the following, that follows: a leanas (na faclan a leanas 'the following words')
the whole of it, altogether: gu lèir (an t-eilean gu lèir 'the whole island')
per, for each: anns gach (sa cheud 'per cent', san latha 'per day')
working: ag obair, verbal noun of obraich (tha mi ag obair 'I am working')
within, inside: taobh a-staigh + genitive (taobh a-staigh na h-uaire 'within the hour')
be able to: is urrainn do + verbal noun
a social gathering, a céilidh, a visit
social, of the community (after the noun: cùisean na coimhearsnachd 'social matters')
given (past participle of thoir: air a thoirt 'having been given')
mind, pay heed, take care (thoir an aire 'watch out')
mind, object to (a bheil e gu diofar leat? 'do you mind?'); never mind: coma leat
coming: a' tighinn, verbal noun of thig
coming, next, to come: ri teachd (an t-seachdain ri teachd 'the coming week')
a problem, a puzzle, a riddle
south (an àird a deas 'the south'; mu dheas 'southwards, in the south')
fuck! (an oath): Mac an donais! 'son of the devil!'
lose (a fight or game), be defeated
taking: a' gabhail (verbal noun of gabh); a' toirt (verbal noun of thoir)
along, throughout, all over: air feadh + genitive (air feadh an rathaid 'along the road')
anyone: duine sam bith, neach sam bith; in questions and negatives duine (a bheil duine ann?)
else, other (after the noun: cò eile? 'who else?', àite eile 'somewhere else')
matter, be of importance (chan eil e gu diofar 'it doesn't matter')
pretty, rather, fairly (caran fuar 'pretty cold'; gu math 'pretty well')
an air, a tune, a melody
a hit, a blow, a stroke
saying: ag ràdh, verbal noun of abair (irregular)
yeah, yes: Seadh 'it is so'; usually one echoes the verb (Tha. / Bha.)
comes (third person of come): thig e 'he will come / he comes', thàinig e 'he came'; tha e a' tighinn 'he is coming'
possible, that can be done (a ghabhas dèanamh)
possible, able to happen: a ghabhas dèanamh; is dòcha 'maybe, it is possible'
wanted (past of want): dh'iarr (from iarr 'want, ask'); bha ... a dhìth air 'he wanted, lacked'
cause, case, a cause fought for
due, owing, to be paid (ri phàigheadh)
due to, because of: air sgàth + genitive
a human, a person, a man
member of a group; a limb
north (an àird a tuath 'the north'; mu thuath 'northwards, in the north')
north, northern (mu thuath: an ceann mu thuath 'the north end')
saw (past of see): chunnaic (from faic, irregular; dependent faca)
a watch, a vigil, a guard
either ... or: an dàrna cuid ... no (an dàrna cuid an-diugh no a-màireach 'either today or tomorrow')
either, neither (in a negative: cha tèid mise nas motha 'I won't go either')
either, one or the other (an dàrna fear 'either one')
fucking (an intensifying oath): diabhlaidh 'devilish' (an rud diabhlaidh ud 'that fucking thing')
whether, in indirect questions: an (am before b f m p) + dependent verb (faighnich an tig e 'ask whether he will come')
whether (or not), in any case: co-dhiù
among: am measg + genitive (am measc nan daoine 'among the people'); with a pronoun, the possessive (nar measg 'among us')
further, farther: nas fhaide (comparative of fada)
yourself: thu fhèin (one, familiar), sibh fhèin (polite or plural)
major, chief, principal (before the noun, lenites)
behind: air cùlaibh + genitive (air cùlaibh an taighe 'behind the house'); with a pronoun, the possessive (air mo chùlaibh)
gonna (going to): a' dol a + verbal noun (tha mi a' dol a dh'ithe 'I'm gonna eat')
non-, un-, in-: the prefix neo- (neo-thròcaireach 'merciless')
political, of ruling and government (after the noun: cùis riaghlaidh 'a political matter')
west (an àird an iar 'the west'; an iar 'westwards, in the west')
of one's own accord: dheth fhèin (thàinig e dheth fhèin 'he came of his own accord')
a final, the last game or contest
former, one-time (before the noun: seann + lenition, seann rìgh 'a former king')
former, earlier, previous (a bha ann roimhe)
in front of: air beulaibh + genitive
current, present (an-dràsta: an rìgh a th' ann an-dràsta 'the current king')
meet (someone new), get to know (cuir eòlas air)
a study, a piece of research
across, over: tarsainn + genitive (tarsainn na h-aibhne 'across the river'); thairis air
self, one's own person (fèin- in compounds: fèin-spèis 'self-esteem')
instead, in its place: an àite sin
main, chief, principal (before the noun, lenites: prìomh rathad 'main road')
fine, good, well (gu math 'fine': tha mi gu math)
outer space, the void beyond the sky
term, season, a period of the year
date, day of the month (dè an ceann-latha an-diugh? 'what is the date today?')
date, a tryst, an appointment to meet
date, go out with (rach a-mach le)
miss, fail to hit, go past (rach seachad air)
a shot, a discharge, a bullet
a shot, an attempt, a turn (feuch oidhirp 'take a shot')
site, place, ruin, foundation of a building
record, register, list; a disc of recorded music
above, over: os cionn + genitive (os cionn na mara 'above the sea'); with a pronoun, the possessive (os mo chionn)
lead, the front place (air thoiseach 'in the lead')
military, of war (after the noun: seirbheis cogaidh 'military service')
interest, attention (tha ùidh agam ann 'I am interested in it')
society, the community, people at large
alone, on one's own: na aonar (with a possessive: nam aonar 'I alone', na h-aonar 'she alone')
a certain, some (àraidh after the noun: latha àraidh 'a certain day')
east (an àird an ear 'the east'; an ear 'eastwards, in the east')
medical, of healing (after the noun: eòlas leighis 'medical knowledge')
the press, printing; a printing press
role, part in a play or deed
worth, worthwhile: is fhiach (is fhiach e 'it is worth it')
whatever: ge b' e dè (ge b' e dè a thachras 'whatever happens')
whatever, any at all: noun + sam bith
league, alliance, federation; a league of teams
management, the governing of a thing
a match, an equal (cha robh a leithid ann 'he had no match')
mom, mum, mother (familiar; a child says a mhàthair!)
range of hills, a row, a series
upon, on: air (air a' chnoc 'upon the hill'); with pronouns orm, ort, air, oirre
various, many a, divers: iomadh + singular noun (iomadh seòrsa 'various kinds')
cannot: chan urrainn do + verbal noun (chan urrainn dhomh 'I cannot'); of things, cha ghabh (cha ghabh e dèanamh 'it cannot be done')
character, a person in a story or play
character, a letter, a written sign
chief, chieftain, head of a clan
football, the game and the ball
economic, of wealth and trade (after the noun: fàs maoine 'economic growth')
title, name (of a book or song)
be born: rugadh (past passive of beir: rugadh e 'he was born')
technology, the applied science of machines (a loan of the machine age)
code, instructions written for a machine
code, body of rules, a rule
considered, regarded, reckoned (air a mheas mar ... 'considered as ...')
crazy, mad, out of one's mind
figure, shape, form of the body
whose (relative): aig a bheil ... (am fear aig a bheil an taigh 'the man whose house it is'); interrogative: cò leis? (cò leis a tha seo? 'whose is this?')
sir (in address): a dhuine uasail 'O noble man'
Sir, the title of a knight
towards: a dh'ionnsaigh + genitive (a dh'ionnsaigh a' bhaile 'towards the town'); with a pronoun, the possessive (dham ionnsaigh 'towards me')
access, opportunity, the chance to use
below, under; lenites (fo thalamh 'below ground'); with pronouns fodham, fodhad, fodha, foidhpe
pass, a way through the mountains
professional, of a calling or profession
a professional, an expert at a craft
mine: leamsa (is ann leamsa a tha e 'it is mine'), agamsa
wanna (want to): ag iarraidh + verbal noun (tha mi ag iarraidh falbh 'I wanna go'); is toil leam 'I'd like'
fan, a device for cooling air
included, taken in (an lùib, air a ghabhail a-steach)
charge, care, keeping (fo chùram 'in charge of')
charge (with a crime), accuse (cuir às leth)
except, but, other than: ach (a h-uile duine ach Iain 'everyone except Iain'); ach a-mhàin
moving: a' gluasad (verbal noun of gluais)
via, by way of: tro + lenition (tro Ghlaschu 'via Glasgow'); rathad + genitive
capital, principal wealth, stock of money
gas, petrol, fuel for an engine
pressure (in the body or in physics), squeezing
credit, honour, praise (bi X an urram 'be to one's credit')
individual, separate, each one: fa leth (gach duine fa leth 'each individual person')
join, come together with (thig còmhla ri)
previous, earlier, former (a bha ann roimhe)
contact, get in touch with (cuir fios gu)
throughout: air feadh + genitive (air feadh na tìre 'throughout the land')
beyond, over: thar + genitive, lenites (thar na mara 'beyond the sea')
beyond, on the far side, yonder
favourite (the X as fheàrr leam 'my favourite X')
favourite, best-loved: as fheàrr le (an t-òran as fheàrr leam 'my favourite song')
movement, a cause taken up by many
scene, a part of a play
expected, looked for (ris an robh dùil)
wow!: Abair! (abair latha! 'what a day!'); Obh obh!
dad, father (familiar; a child says m' athair, a athair!)
fit, a seizure, a sudden bout
generally, on the whole: san fharsaingeachd
gotta (have got to): feumaidh + subject + verbal noun (feumaidh mi falbh 'I gotta go')
interested (tha ùidh aig X ann an Y: tha ùidh agam ann an eachdraidh 'I'm interested in history')
lady, a woman of rank, the lady of a house
nobody: duine or neach with a negative verb (chan fhaca mi duine 'I saw nobody'); cha robh duine ann 'there was nobody there'
plus, and (trì agus dhà 'three plus two')
plus, in addition to: a bharrachd air
pre-, fore-: the prefix ro- + lenition (ro-làimh 'beforehand', ro-ràdh 'foreword')
anymore, any longer: tuilleadh (with a negative: chan eil e ann tuilleadh 'he's not here anymore')
pro-, for, in favour of: airson, às leth (tha mi airson an rìgh 'I'm pro the king')
a pro, a professional, an expert
direction, way, bearing (an comhair a chinn 'headfirst, in his head's direction')
none, not one: gin with a negative verb (chan eil gin agam 'I have none'); chan eil aon ann 'there is none'
stock, a share in a company
lack, want, need (tha X a dhìth orm 'I lack X')
senior, higher in rank (before the noun, lenites: àrd-oifigeach)
luck, fortune (sealbh ort! 'good luck to you!')
supposed to: tha còir aig X a bhith / + verbal noun (tha còir agam a bhith ann 'I'm supposed to be there')
overall, on the whole: san fharsaingeachd
highly, greatly, very: gu mòr; glè + lenition
holding: a' cumail (verbal noun of cùm)
primary, chief, first (before the noun, lenites)
agency, a body acting for others
agency, means, action (tro obair 'through the agency of')
cell, a small room, a prison cell
executive, an officer who governs affairs
mission, a quest, a journey on a purpose
sitting, seated: na shuidhe (tha mi nam shuidhe 'I am sitting', tha i na suidhe 'she is sitting')
standing: na sheasamh (tha mi nam sheasamh 'I am standing')
actual, very, the very (before the noun: an dearbh rud 'the actual thing')
appear, seem: tha coltas air (tha coltas an uisce air 'it appears like rain')
fell, cut down (a tree), knock down
glass, the material; a drinking glass
northern, in the north: mu thuath (after the noun: an ceann mu thuath 'the northern end'); a Tuathach is a northerner of Rodos
placed (past of place): chuir (from cuir); air a chur 'having been placed'
prior to, before: ro + lenition (ron chath 'prior to the battle')
religious, of faith (after the noun: ceist creidimh 'a religious question')
a ride, a journey (on horseback or in a cart)
whom: cò (interrogative: cò ris a bha thu a' bruidhinn? 'to whom were you speaking?'); relative a (+ lenition)
benefit, good (math: airson do mhath 'for your benefit')
bottom, root, foot (of a hill or tree)
everybody: a h-uile duine, gach duine
southern, in the south: mu dheas (after the noun: an ceann mu dheas 'the southern end')
cent, a penny, a small coin
per cent: sa cheud (fichead sa cheud 'twenty per cent')
fourth: an ceathramh (an ceathramh latha 'the fourth day')
mental, of the mind (after the noun: slàinte-inntinn 'mental health')
acting, standing in (an àite X 'acting for X')
generation (glùin, 'knee', the old count of descent)
generation, the people of an age
profile, side view of a face
profile, a description of a person
apply, put into effect (cuir an sàs)
apply (for something), put in a request (cuir a-steach airson)
